_meta.description: Index of all Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) for the ecommerce platform.

adrs.title: Country-First Localization
adrs.summary: Country is the primary business context (tax, currency, shipping). Language is a presentation layer. URL structure: /{country}/{lang}/{path}.
key_invariants: Business config keyed by country_id, not language
CMS content keyed by (country_id, language_code)
Region config (tax/currency/shipping) is country-specific

adrs.title: Order Immutability via Snapshot Pattern
adrs.summary: Order pricing, line items, and addresses are captured as immutable snapshots at order creation time. Three snapshot types: pricing_snapshot JSON, order_items.snapshot JSON, order_address_snapshots table.
key_invariants: orders.pricing_snapshot is never updated after insertion
order_items.snapshot is never updated after insertion
order_address_snapshots rows are never updated
Refunds always use order_items.unit_price, not current prices

adrs.title: CMS Inheritance Model
adrs.summary: CMS content uses country-first inheritance: locale-level content inherits from country-level by default. Three states: inherited (NULL), overridden (content JSON), detached (empty JSON). Breaking inheritance requires explicit cms:break_inheritance permission.
key_invariants: NULL content in localized_cms_pages = inherit from country default lang
No global/master content layer — country is the base
Fallback chain: exact locale → country default lang → 404

adrs.title: Server-Side Pricing
adrs.summary: All authoritative pricing is calculated server-side. calculatePricing() is a pure function called from cart mutations, checkout validation, and order creation. Client never submits prices — only variant_id and quantity.
key_invariants: Client submits variant_id + quantity only — never prices
calculatePricing() is always called server-side for authoritative pricing
round2() used for all monetary calculations
Price changes detected at PRICE_CHANGE_TOLERANCE = 0.01

adrs.title: Service-Role Client Pattern
adrs.summary: Domain services use createServiceClient() (bypasses RLS) to support guest operations and cross-table transactions. Security enforced at application service layer via ownership assertions (assertCartOwnership, assertAddressOwnership).
key_invariants: createServiceClient() only imported in src/lib/ (never in route handlers)
Every service method using service client calls ownership assertion
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is server-only (not NEXT_PUBLIC_)

adrs.title: Atomic Order Creation via PostgreSQL RPC
adrs.summary: All order creation logic in single PostgreSQL function create_order_atomic(). Prevents race conditions (overselling, coupon abuse) via row-level locking in sorted variantId order. Returns specific error codes for business failures.
key_invariants: create_order_atomic() is the ONLY valid order creation path
Inventory locks acquired in variantId sort order (deadlock prevention)
Coupon re-validated inside transaction (prevents race condition)
Error codes: P0001 (stock), P0003 (coupon limit), P0004 (coupon reuse)

adrs.title: Server-Authoritative Cart with Client Cache
adrs.summary: Cart state lives in Supabase DB (server-authoritative). Zustand store is display cache only. Guest carts use httpOnly cookie (256-bit entropy). Every cart mutation hits the server.
key_invariants: Zustand serverCart is always populated from server response, never computed locally
guest_cart_session cookie is httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 30-day TTL
Only active status carts allow mutations

pending_adrs.title: Delivery Layer Abstraction
pending_adrs.summary: CMS content delivery should be abstracted from storage mechanism. Future: headless CMS swap possible.

pending_adrs.title: Multi-Currency Architecture
pending_adrs.summary: Cross-border purchases require exchange rate capture at order time. Pricing engine extension needed.

pending_adrs.title: External Tax Provider Integration
pending_adrs.summary: Replace getTaxConfig() with Avalara/TaxJar API for accurate real-time tax rates. Interface already abstracted.
